$comment: Curated allowlist of font families built from Chairzard/WP-Fonts. 'source' is the folder path inside that repo; add a family here and the build picks it up. All family names must match [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ (firmware constraint).

families.name: WPCharter
families.title: Charter (XCharter)
families.description: Bitstream Charter descendant, sturdy strokes — the classic e-ink book face.

families.name: WPGaramond
families.title: EB Garamond
families.description: Old-style book face; light and compact at small sizes.
families.$licenseNote: WP-Fonts ships no license file for this folder; the OFL is carried from the canonical google/fonts copy.

families.name: WPIlliterata
families.title: Literata
families.description: Google's e-reader face; even color, strong at 6-9pt.

families.name: WPFexofenadine
families.title: Alegreya
families.description: Warm calligraphic book serif with generous italics.

families.name: WPStickler
families.source: Modified Fonts/STIX Two Text - WP Stickler
families.title: STIX Two Text
families.description: Academic serif (Times lineage), clean at small sizes.

families.name: WPSSerif
families.title: Source Serif 4
families.description: Adobe's workhorse text serif, sturdy and even.

families.name: WPArol
families.title: Lora
families.description: Brushed serif with good contrast for long reading.

families.name: WPSeeingRed
families.source: Modified Fonts/Crimson Pro - WP Seeing Red
families.title: Crimson Pro
families.description: Light, economical old-style serif; lots of text per page.

families.name: WPPeteySerif
families.source: Modified Fonts/PT Serif - WP Petey Serif
families.title: PT Serif
families.description: Compact humanist serif that stays crisp at 6-8pt.

families.name: WPSorberto
families.title: Gelasio
families.description: Metrically Georgia-compatible — the classic e-reader feel.

families.name: WPKorn
families.title: Vollkorn
families.description: Sturdy German book face; dark, even strokes on e-ink.

families.name: WPBittersweet
families.title: Bitter
families.description: Slab serif that reads like a crisper Bookerly.
